title: Comfy-Org MiniMax H3 Text-to-Video workflow
claims: UI JSON uses the native MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo subgraph, ResolutionSelector, res_multistep sampler and a 20-step base path with optional turbo controls.
The graph lists minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors, qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors, video/audio VAE files, and optional FL2V Turbo LoRA URLs.
The native canvas is documented as a 768px short edge capped at 1344x768 and duration is snapped to the 17k+5 frame grid at 24fps.

resources.precision: int8 ConvRot diffusion; NVFP4-AWQ text encoder; VAE files as named

limitations: No L4 or single-A100 run, peak VRAM, host RAM, or quality acceptance was read.
FL2VA and Ref2VA are distinct model contracts.

contracts.sampler: res_multistep; simple/base 20 steps; turbo branch documented separately

title: Comfy-Org MiniMax H3 Image-to-Video workflow
claims: The UI graph exposes first_frame and last_frame as optional IMAGE inputs on MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo.
The graph uses the FL2VA diffusion model and shared Qwen3-VL/text and video/audio VAE files; turbo mode changes to the listed H3 FL2V LoRA path.
The official guide says I2V can use one or both keyframes and keeps the same 768px-short-edge and 17k+5 frame rules.

resources.precision: int8 ConvRot diffusion; NVFP4-AWQ text encoder

limitations: No target-GPU run or paired first/last-frame quality result.
A first/last image is an input contract, not a V2V workflow.

title: Comfy-Org MiniMax H3 Reference-to-Video workflow
claims: The graph uses MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo and a separate minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors diffusion file.
The documented reference inputs are up to 9 images, 3 videos with optional paired soundtracks, and 3 standalone audio clips.
The graph documents ref_image_size match versus max, res_multistep sampling, and packed video/audio latent decoding.

resources.resolution: H3 native canvas documented up to 1344x768
resources.precision: int8 ConvRot Ref2VA; NVFP4-AWQ text encoder

limitations: Ref2VA is not interchangeable with FL2VA or FastH3 V2.
No hardware timing, peak memory, or controlled identity/quality score.

contracts.sampler: res_multistep; official note says beta/normal can outperform simple for reference-heavy prompts

title: Comfy-Org FastH3 8-Step V2 T2VA/FL2VA templates
claims: The current raw template names fastvideo_fasth3_8step_v2_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors and uses native MiniMax H3 multimodal nodes with Comfy kitchen attention.
Official docs require ComfyUI 0.36.0 or later, fixed 8 steps, H3 17k+5 frame grid at 24fps, and scope limited to T2VA/FL2VA; Ref2VA was not distilled.
The workflow notes VSA keep_percent 10 starting at 20% schedule and H3 video/audio sigma shifts 10/3.

resources.precision: int8 V2 diffusion; shared H3 NVFP4 text/VAE files

limitations: Changing the fixed 8-step schedule is documented as quality degrading.
No L4/A100 output or peak memory; V2 must not be mixed with the older 4-step VSA checkpoint.
node_dependencies: Comfy Kitchen attention build as selected by template

contracts.sampler: res_multistep + simple, exactly 8 steps; sigma shift video=10/audio=3; VSA keep_percent=10

title: Comfy-Org Wan2.1 VACE T2V/I2V/V2V workflow family
claims: The template includes WanVaceToVideo, KSampler, Wan VAE, UMT5 and optional CausVid LoRA branches; VACE accepts control_video, control_masks and reference_image inputs.
The in-graph note states VACE-1.3B supports 480P only and VACE-14B supports 480P and 720P.
Official tutorial documents reference-to-video, control-video V2V, inpainting, outpainting and first/last-frame variants; V2V may use preprocessed depth/Canny inputs.

resources.precision: fp16 VACE/UMT5 in documented default; LoRA branch optional

limitations: Tutorial timing is RTX 4090 only: 81f 720P about 40min and 49f 640x640 about 7min.
Base 20-step and CausVid 2-4-step branches coexist; they are not one universal setting.
No target GPU quality or memory acceptance.

contracts.sampler: native KSampler; template note base steps=20/cfg=6 and CausVid steps=2-4/cfg=1

title: Comfy-Org Wan2.2 Animate character replace / move workflow
claims: The graph uses WanAnimateToVideo with a reference image, pose/driving video, CLIP Vision and segmentation/preprocessing nodes; it exposes Mix character replace and Move pose transfer modes.
The graph lists fp8 17.14GB and BF16 32.18GB Animate diffusion alternatives, UMT5, CLIP Vision, Wan VAE, LightX2V I2V LoRA and Relight LoRA.
The built-in node contract requires width/height multiples of 16, length multiple of 4, and supports pose_strength, pose/reference strengths, continuation and video_frame_offset.

resources.precision: fp8 or bf16 Animate diffusion; UMT5 fp8; CLIP Vision

limitations: No target GPU timing/peak memory; graph has segmentation and preprocessing assets beyond core weights.
Long/high-resolution video is explicitly an OOM risk in template notes.

contracts.sampler: WanAnimateToVideo creates conditioning/start latent; downstream sampler branch is graph-defined

title: WanVideoWrapper 14B first/last-frame example
claims: The UI JSON contains WanVideoModelLoader, WanVideoBlockSwap, WanVideoLoraSelect, WanVideoClipVisionEncode, WanVideoSampler and WanVideoDecode, with explicit start/end image Set/Get nodes.
The example uses block swap 20 and a LightX2V I2V 14B 480p LoRA; README says text encoder, CLIP Vision, transformer and VAE each have dedicated model locations.
The wrapper README says GGUF can load in the main model loader but also warns the project is WIP and model-specific node types are not generally mixable.

resources.precision: fp8 scaled/GGUF options documented; example uses wrapper model loader
resources.offload: block swap node set to 20 in example

limitations: No L4/A100 first-hand timing or quality; README examples are other GPUs/tasks.
Wrapper/native/WanVideoWrapper model objects cannot be assumed interchangeable.
Compile/cache behavior and LoRA resident memory vary with block swap.
node_dependencies: ComfyUI-KJNodes for utility nodes in example

contracts.sampler: WanVideoSampler owns steps/cfg/shift/scheduler/offload/context/cache inputs; exact values vary by example

title: Wan2.2 VACE-Fun A14B control-video UI workflow
claims: The UI JSON uses LoadWan2_2VaceFunModel with Wan2.2-VACE-Fun-A14B, sequential_cpu_offload, and Wan2.2 sampler inputs for control_video, optional start/end images and subject reference images.
The example has 81 frames, width 640, 50 steps, cfg 6, Flow scheduler, shift 12 and a VHS video load/combine path at 16fps.
VideoX-Fun docs list A14B control/inpaint weights at 64.0GB and 5B control weights at 23.0GB; the ComfyUI install requires VideoX-Fun, VideoHelperSuite and KJNodes.
limitations: Weight file size is not a VRAM peak or A100/L4 run result.
No direct target-GPU video/timing/quality evidence.

contracts.sampler: Flow; 50 steps; cfg 6; shift 12 in example

title: ComfyUI-FastH3-VSA strict T2VA proof workflow
claims: The JSON wires UNETLoader to FastH3VSAPatch, then MiniMaxH3SigmaShift video=12/audio=3, native H3 conditioning, simple 4-step scheduler and audio/video decode.

The repository README reports a local strict-VSA generation of 5.17 seconds at 608x352 and 124 frames with synchronized stereo audio, 300 VSA calls and zero fallbacks; GPU and host RAM are not stated.
The repository requires a pinned ComfyUI compatibility patch and a specific Comfy Kitchen Actions artifact; it explicitly says minimum VRAM is unknown and rejects MultiGPU clones.
limitations: The 5.17s result is a local author report with no GPU identity, RAM, seed or complete command log.
Experimental patch changes ComfyUI core files; ordinary PyPI comfy-kitchen wheel is explicitly the wrong binary for this preview.

contracts.sampler: 4 steps, simple, res_multistep; VSA keep_percent=10; sigma shift 12/3

title: Lightricks ComfyUI-LTXVideo LTX-2.3 single-stage distilled full workflow
claims: The full UI JSON contains LTXVConditioning, EmptyLTXVLatentVideo/Audio, LTXVConcatAVLatent/SeparateAVLatent, LTXVScheduler, MultimodalGuider, LTXVPreprocess and audio/video VAE nodes.
The graph uses ltx-2.3-22b-dev.safetensors and a Gemma 3 text encoder path; the JSON also contains an optional GemmaAPITextEncode/API-key branch.
Lightricks README states a CUDA GPU with 32GB+ VRAM and 100GB+ free disk before using LTX-2 workflows.

resources.precision: 22B dev checkpoint; exact runtime precision depends on model file/loader

target_profiles.A100_40GB: possible by VRAM prerequisite only; no run
target_profiles.A100_80GB: possible by VRAM prerequisite only; no run

limitations: 32GB+/100GB are nodepack prerequisites, not a measured A100 benchmark.
API key branch and local encoder branch must not be conflated; no L4 result.
node_dependencies: local Gemma encoder or optional LTX API path

contracts.sampler: LTXVScheduler/manual sigmas and MultimodalGuider; exact graph has multiple sampler stages

title: Kijai ComfyUI-FramePackWrapper HV example
claims: The UI JSON uses DownloadAndLoadFramePackModel, FramePackFindNearestBucket, FramePackSampler, CLIPVisionEncode and VAEEncode, with optional start/end latent and image embedding interpolation.
README permits either autodownload to a diffusers directory or a single FP8/BF16 transformer file; text encoder, VAE and SigCLIP come from Comfy-Org HunyuanVideo repackaged/sigclip repos.
FramePackSampler exposes steps, TeaCache threshold, cfg, guidance_scale, latent_window_size, total_second_length and GPU memory preservation.

resources.resolution: nearest bucket; example graph input 704x544 image path
resources.offload: load_device/offload and gpu_memory_preservation controls in node

limitations: Wrapper README is explicitly WIP; a KJNodes issue reports missing-node/load errors.
Upstream FramePack 6GB claims are not wrapper-specific validation and no target-GPU timing was read.

contracts.sampler: FramePackSampler; default node steps=30, cfg=1, guidance_scale=10, latent_window_size=9, total_second_length=5

title: Comfy-Org Hunyuan Video text-to-video workflow
claims: The graph uses EmptyHunyuanLatentVideo at 848x480x73, Euler sampler, simple scheduler at 20 steps, ModelSamplingSD3=7 and FluxGuidance=6.
The graph loads HunyuanVideo T2V 720p BF16 and Hunyuan VAE, with a note to select FP8 weight_dtype when memory is insufficient.
VAEDecodeTiled is the default path with tile_size 256, overlap 64/64 and temporal tile 8.

resources.precision: BF16 default; FP8 weight_dtype fallback note

limitations: T2V-only graph; no target-GPU run or visual acceptance.
Tiled decode lowers decode-memory pressure but does not establish end-to-end VRAM.

title: Cordux Wan2.2 14B low-VRAM T2V/I2V GGUF workflow
claims: The UI JSON includes city96 GGUF loading plus rgthree, cg-use-everywhere, Easy-Use, VHS, KJNodes, memory cleanup, custom scripts and efficiency nodes.
The README defines Q3/Q4/Q5 main GGUF, city96 UMT5 Q3_K_M/Q4_K_M, Wan VAE, 512x512 default, FPS*seconds+1 frame calculation, T2V/I2V toggle and last-frame chaining.
Author benchmark reports RTX 3050 6GB, 1 second/16 frames at 15fps, 4 steps, about 4.6 minutes; model loading, sampling and VAE decode are separated.

resources.precision: Q4_K main + Q3_K_M UMT5 in tested configuration

limitations: The rapid-AIO model is a third-party merge; no controlled comparison to official Wan2.2.
RTX3050 data cannot be promoted to L4/A100 results; no quality score beyond author wording.

contracts.sampler: 4-step rapid-AIO graph; GGUF loader and CPU offload are required for intended low-VRAM path

title: safzanpirani Wan2.1 I2V GGUF upscale and frame-interpolation workflow
claims: The repository describes a complete Wan2.1 I2V GGUF generation -> upscale -> frame interpolation workflow and provides a drag/drop JSON plus PNG metadata workflow.
README lists KJNodes, rgthree, VideoHelperSuite, city96 ComfyUI-GGUF and ComfyUI Frame Interpolation for the video graph.
README names city96 Wan2.1 I2V 14B 480P Q6_K GGUF, UMT5 FP8, Wan VAE and CLIP Vision as model inputs.

resources.resolution: Wan2.1 480P I2V source; upscale target not stated
resources.workflow: ComfyUI editor/UI JSON and PNG metadata

limitations: No target-GPU benchmark, peak VRAM/RAM or quality acceptance in the repository.
Post-processing node requirements and model versions must be installed together.

contracts.sampler: graph-defined; post-generation upscale and interpolation branches
